description: Xeon Phi 5110P (60 cores, 1.053 GHz, 8 GB GDDR5, 320 GB/s peak). Card constants are Intel's published specification. Latencies come from published measurements on 5100-series or similar systems (R06 engineering sample at 1 GHz, R07 5100-series at 1.05 GHz, R08 SE10P). None was measured by this project; nothing here is calibrated against a card the project owns.

calibration.statement: No native measurement imported. Values marked literature were measured by other authors on other samples.

card.model.source: Intel product specification (ark.intel.com, Xeon Phi Coprocessor 5110P)

card.usable_cores.source: one core reserved for the card OS in the usual native configuration; not measured

latency.vector_long.source: transferred from the project's 7120-class card measurement (S6-03); same core design

latency.vector_convert_df.source: transferred from S6-03 on the 7120-class card

latency.memory.source: R06 §5.1.1 (318-346 cycles at 1 GHz on an engineering sample); R08 ~300 cycles at 1.1 GHz

latency.remote_l2_line_ns.source: R06 §5.1.2 (about 243 cycles at 1 GHz, sd 32); R08 ~275 ns

latency.branch_mispredict_penalty.source: not measured on a 5110P by any imported source

latency.gather_first_line.source: transferred from S6-03 on the 7120-class card

occupancy.gather_cycles_per_line.source: transferred from S6-03 on the 7120-class card

card.sustained_bandwidth_gbs.source: R09 reports pre-production STREAM figures only; not imported
